cards.hook: This should add up ten numbers. It outputs only the last one. Tap the broken line.
cards.answer: Line 4 overwrites Total every time. It must be Total ← Total + Number.

cards.subject: computer_science
cards.hook: Your phone screen ignores a pen but reacts to your finger. That is a ____ touchscreen.
cards.answer: Capacitive screens sense the change in the electric field caused by a conductor such as skin. Resistive screens react to pressure, so a pen works too.
